Add 3D holograms & special FX, paint & sculpt in 3D.

quotes.text:
Paint-AR is a surreal new Augmented Reality app. Paint, add holograms & live FX. 3D print or export your creations to other VR apps or games. Join featured artists, record videos & share. Use GearVR or cardboard for holographic viewing in VR+AR mode.

Download Paint-AR for iPhone or iPad (free):
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paint-ar/id1347083887

Video preview:
https://youtu.be/AzlLtZmAyMY

More info:
https://Paint-AR.com
https://www.producthunt.com/r/2527c169b26e8e

Any feedback from the HN community, artists, app developers or AR/VR enthusiasts welcome! Droid & Magic Leap versions of Paint-AR with improved UI & tutorial coming soon.
